name: hopemind-safemindlive
description: HopeMind - Plataforma de Saúde Mental (PWA + NestJS + React SPA) - Padrão SafeMindLive

scripts.setup: cd backend && npx prisma db push && npx prisma db seed
scripts.migrate: cd backend && npx prisma db push
scripts.seed: cd backend && npx prisma db seed
scripts.db:reset: cd backend && npx prisma db push --force-reset && npx prisma db seed
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
